outcome: Severity of borderline personality disorder (BPD) symptoms
cohort: The study included 307 adolescent mothers (14-18 years) and 307 never-pregnant adolescents, matched on age, race, and household public assistance.
finding: Pregnant adolescents reported more severe borderline personality disorder symptoms compared to their non-pregnant peers, a difference that was sustained for three years postpartum, while no group differences were found for depression severity.
